description: Stable diagnostic identifiers emitted by the gaussian-splat plugin. Codes are never renumbered or reused; messages may be reworded. Every message starts with its bracketed code, e.g. "[GSSPLAT-E002] ...".

diagnostics.action: Provide a .splat file containing at least one 32-byte record.

diagnostics.summary: The file size is not a multiple of the 32-byte .splat record size, so the last record is incomplete.
diagnostics.action: The file was cut short or is not a .splat file; obtain a complete copy or re-export it.

diagnostics.summary: The file starts with the signature of another format (PLY, SPZ version 4, a ZIP archive such as a bundled SOG, or binary glTF), so it is not a .splat file.
diagnostics.action: The file was probably renamed; open it with the extension of the format it actually is.

diagnostics.summary: The record count implied by the file size exceeds the shared import limit of 8,000,000 Gaussians.
diagnostics.action: Split or decimate the asset before import.

diagnostics.summary: The file could not be opened or read completely.
diagnostics.action: Check that the path exists, is a regular file, and is readable, and that it is not being modified during import.

diagnostics.summary: A record stores a non-finite (NaN or infinite) position.
diagnostics.action: Re-export the asset; a valid writer stores finite float32 positions.

diagnostics.summary: A record stores a scale that is zero, negative, or not finite. .splat stores linear scales, which a valid writer always makes positive.
diagnostics.action: Re-export the asset. If the file is not a .splat file, open it with its original extension.

diagnostics.summary: The decoded cloud failed shared model validation before authoring. The decoder should have rejected the input with a more specific code first.
diagnostics.action: Report a bug against usd-3dgs-plugins with the file; this indicates a decoder gap rather than a normal malformed-input failure.

diagnostics.summary: The record buffer or the model arrays for the file's Gaussian count could not be allocated.
diagnostics.action: Free memory or split the asset before import.

diagnostics.summary: Internal misuse of the import pipeline (null output parameters, inconsistent record buffers). Not reachable from file content.
diagnostics.action: Report a bug against usd-3dgs-plugins with the reproduction.

diagnostics.summary: The in-memory USD stage could not be created.
diagnostics.action: Check the OpenUSD installation and plugin registration; this failure is environmental, not file content.

diagnostics.summary: The /Asset or /Asset/Splat prim could not be defined on the generated layer.
diagnostics.action: Report a bug against usd-3dgs-plugins; the authoring scaffold is fixed and should always succeed on a healthy stage.

diagnostics.summary: An attribute value could not be authored on the generated layer.
diagnostics.action: Report a bug against usd-3dgs-plugins with the file that triggered it.

diagnostics.summary: The extent computation overflowed to a non-finite bound.
diagnostics.action: The decoded positions or scales are at the edge of float range; re-export the asset with values inside a renderable range.

diagnostics.summary: Writing USD content back to .splat is unsupported; the plugin is read-only.
diagnostics.action: Export through a Gaussian Splatting tool; USD-to-.splat conversion is out of scope for this plugin.

diagnostics.summary: One or more records store a zero rotation (all four rotation bytes 128); those Gaussians were given the identity orientation.
diagnostics.action: None required. Re-export the asset if the orientation matters.
